 Default: 2.0
 Range: 0.0 ~ 100000.0
options.label: Chassis Drain per Part

options.comment:
Rack-local lanes each Access Card in a Chassis Switch gives the other devices in its rack.
 Default: 48
 Range: 0 ~ 1024
options.label: Access Card Lanes

options.comment:
Items a second each Routing Card in a Chassis Switch moves between segments (the cards add up).
 Default: 128
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000
options.label: Routing Card Rate (items/s)

options.comment:
How much more a blade gives per rack unit than its server (Compute, Memory): % on top of the server's rate per U.
 Default: 25
 Range: 0 ~ 1000
options.label: Blade Bonus per Rack Unit (%)

options.comment:
Lanes a Blade Enclosure's Interconnect Module gives its blades (the blades take none of the rack's).
 Default: 64
 Range: 1 ~ 1024
options.label: Interconnect Lanes

options.comment:
Spooled files a system keeps; past this the oldest is removed.
 Default: 200
 Range: 1 ~ 100000

Messages each user's message queue keeps; past this the oldest is removed.
 Default: 500
 Range: 1 ~ 100000

Characters of source member text that take one byte of the network's drive storage (rounded up per member).
 Default: 64
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000
Whether SNDMSG also tells online recipients in chat that a message is waiting.

VM instructions an interactive job runs per tick before it yields.
 Default: 200
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000

VM instructions each batch job runs per tick before it yields.
 Default: 100
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000

VM instructions all jobs on the server run per tick, together.
 Default: 2000
 Range: 1 ~ 10000000

Lines a source member may have.
 Default: 5000
 Range: 1 ~ 100000

Elements a *LIST variable may hold.
 Default: 4096
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000

Batch jobs each Compute Server runs at once.
 Default: 4
 Range: 0 ~ 64

Bytes of library source an 8" Diskette holds (SAVLIB).
 Default: 65536
 Range: 1 ~ 16777216

Ended crafting jobs each network's history keeps by default (the CRFLOGRTN system value's default); past this the oldest is removed.
 Default: 200
 Range: 0 ~ 999

Records a physical file (CRTPF) may hold; a write past this is refused (ELC2208).
 Default: 10000
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000

Whether libraries sync with <world>/encodedlogistics/libraries/: AUTO is on in single-player and off on dedicated servers.
Allowed Values: AUTO, TRUE, FALSE

FE per tick a PLC uses while it's powered (from its own buffer, or from its network when cabled to one).
 Default: 2
 Range: 0 ~ 1000
options.label: PLC Energy

options.comment:
FE a PLC's own buffer holds (filled from any face).
 Default: 1000
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000
options.label: PLC Buffer

options.comment:
VM instructions a PLC runs per tick; a scan that needs more carries on next tick.
 Default: 50
 Range: 1 ~ 100000
options.label: PLC Instructions Per Tick

options.comment:
PLCs that may run in one chunk; another stays in STOP (PLC limit reached).
 Default: 16
 Range: 1 ~ 4096
options.label: PLCs Per Chunk

options.comment:
PLCs that may run on the server at once; another stays in STOP (PLC limit reached).
 Default: 512
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000
options.label: PLCs Per Server

options.comment:
What a PLC's outputs do on FAULT: HOLD keeps their last levels, ZERO drops them to 0.
Allowed Values: HOLD, ZERO
options.label: PLC Outputs on Fault

options.comment: Whether anyone may open a PLC that isn't cabled to a network (false: only the player who placed it, and operators).
options.label: Anyone May Open an Unnetworked PLC

options.comment:
FE per tick a Cage Light, Alarm Strobe or Speaker drains from its network while it's cabled to one.
 Default: 0.25
 Range: 0.0 ~ 1000.0
options.label: Signal Device Drain

options.comment:
The farthest an Alarm Strobe's siren can be set to carry, in blocks.
 Default: 96
 Range: 8 ~ 256
options.label: Siren Max Range

options.comment:
The farthest a Speaker can be set to carry, in blocks.
 Default: 64
 Range: 8 ~ 256
options.label: Speaker Max Range

options.comment:
The largest audio file (or web audio) a Speaker plays, in MB.
 Default: 4
 Range: 1 ~ 64
options.label: Audio Max Size (MB)

options.comment:
The longest audio file (or web audio) a Speaker plays, in seconds.
 Default: 180
 Range: 1 ~ 3600
options.label: Audio Max Length (s)

options.comment:
The largest MIDI file a Speaker plays, in KB.
 Default: 256
 Range: 1 ~ 8192

The longest MIDI file a Speaker plays, in seconds.
 Default: 600
 Range: 1 ~ 3600

The most notes one Speaker starts at once (in one tick) from a MIDI file; the quietest beyond it are left out.
 Default: 8
 Range: 1 ~ 64

Whether Speakers may play audio from web URLs (fetched by each listening player's own game): AUTO is on in single-player and off on dedicated servers.
Allowed Values: AUTO, TRUE, FALSE
options.label: Allow Web Audio

options.comment: The hosts Speakers may play web audio from (example.com also allows its subdomains); empty: none.
options.label: Web Audio Hosts

options.comment:
Sort the grid by name, count or mod.
Allowed Values: NAME, COUNT, MOD
options.label: Sort Mode

options.comment: Sort in descending order.
options.label: Sort Descending

options.comment: Show what the network can craft but has none of always (true) or only while searching (false).
options.label: Always Show Craftable

options.comment:
The grid's height: a fixed size, or as many rows as fit the window.
Allowed Values: SMALL, MEDIUM, TALL, FILL
options.label: Grid Height

options.comment:
The grid's tab: everything, items, fluids, pressurized gases, or the energy summary.
Allowed Values: ALL, ITEMS, FLUIDS, PRESSURIZED, ENERGY
Keep the search field in step with JEI's search bar (needs JEI).
options.label: Sync Search with JEI

options.comment: The Terminal Desk's screen colour: green, amber or white (screens/crt/phosphor.json), or *SYSVAL for the system's PHOSPHOR value.
options.label: Terminal Desk Phosphor

options.comment: Show a toast when a crafting job finishes, fails or is cancelled.
options.label: Show Job Toasts

options.comment:
Whose jobs: MINE (the ones you asked for) or ALL (every job on networks you can view).
Allowed Values: MINE, ALL
options.label: Whose Jobs

options.comment: Toast when a job completes.
options.label: When Completed

options.comment: Toast when a job fails.
options.label: When Failed

options.comment: Toast when a job is cancelled.
options.label: When Cancelled

options.comment:
Only toast for jobs that ran at least this many seconds (failures always toast).
 Default: 5
 Range: 0 ~ 3600
options.label: Minimum Job Duration (s)

options.comment: A quiet chime with each toast (a lower tone for failures).
options.label: Chime

options.comment: Play web audio from Speakers. Off by default: playing it means this game fetches the URL itself, which shows your IP address to whoever hosts it.
options.label: Allow Web Audio

options.comment: Hear UPS alarms (the beeps on battery, the rapid low-battery beep, and the beep when power's back). Off silences every UPS for you only.
options.label: Hear UPS Alarms
